tool_arguments.summary:
Comparative gross-margin findings (most recent reported quarters):

- **NVIDIA Q2 fiscal 2027** (quarter ended July 26 2026): **75.0 %** on both GAAP and non‑GAAP basis, on $96.2 B revenue (source S1.1).
- **AMD Q2 fiscal 2027** (quarter ended June 27 2026): **54 %** GAAP and **56 %** non‑GAAP gross margin, on ~$2.24 B revenue (source S2.1).

**Drivers of the gap:** NVIDIA’s data‑center‑centric portfolio (GPUs, AI‑accelerated chips) commands much higher average selling prices and lower relative cost of goods sold than AMD’s broader client‑CPU, GPU, and semi‑custom mix. NVIDIA’s margin is also bolstered by high‑margin software and royalty revenue, whereas AMD’s margin reflects greater exposure to lower‑margin embedded and client‑processor units.

All figures are traceable to the cited SEC/earnings releases.
